name: category
description: Column A of the gemini_categories tab: the name of the category, for example kids. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.

name: mode
description: Column B: Disabled, Shadow or Exclude. Blank means Disabled.

name: min_score
description: Column C: the score from which a video counts as belonging to the category, 0.50 to 1.00 or 50% to 100%. Blank means 0.70. Read as text so that a malformed value is reported in plain language instead of failing the read.

name: description
description: Column D: what the category means. It is given to Gemini as written.
